title: Finished building the Library
text: Ja, so today. Spent most of today building, cooking a proper meal and chatting with the locals. Finished building the Library! Stood back and had a proper look at it. Lekker. Learned a bit about Bangkok. Sun out all day. Lekker. Diesel was a legend today. Pretty sure Diesel was planning to learn the next trick and get ALL the treats. Cheeky. Made 8 coins. Collected 43 bricks. Also: ☀️ Sun's out over the island. 26 coins saved. Every one of them is a kilometre of Thai road. Bed.
tomorrow: Sell some stock at the stall.

title: Built a proper snowman
text: Quick one tonight. Spent most of today building, cooking a proper meal and playing with Diesel. Built a proper snowman: carrot nose, stone eyes and his old orange cap! Stood back and had a proper look at it. Lekker. Drew up plans for something new: 🔭 Stargazer Hill, a little hill with a telescope on top. Every session on Little Thunder makes Thailand feel closer. Worked on tricks with Diesel a few times. Got stuck into Bangkok for a bit. Proper winter day, snow on every roof. Beach time: collecting shells (+3 shells (17 in the jar)). Diesel was a legend today. Pretty sure Diesel was planning to guard the savings jar. Nobody touches the jar. Cheeky. Bought a wheelbarrow: +2 bricks every time he collects. Spent 30 coins. Eish. Collected 62 bricks, used 40 on building. Also: Someone left a box of spare bricks at the pit. +8 bricks. Thailand feels closer today. 482 to go. Night, Diesel.
tomorrow: Sell some stock at the stall.

title: Making a hot chocolate
text: Short and sweet tonight. Spent most of today making a hot chocolate, playing with Diesel and running my market stall. The Rooftop Garden is 1/5 done. Getting there. Learned a bit about Bangkok. It SNOWED. On my island. Still can't believe it. Beach time: collecting shells (+3 shells (14 in the jar)). Diesel slept on my boots again. Can't complain. Pretty sure Diesel was planning to be the greeter at the market stall. Customers love me. Cheeky. Stall made 7 coins today. Made 9 coins. Collected 14 bricks, used 30 on building. Also: Diesel chases a plastic butterfly and misses. Thailand feels closer today. 452 to go. Tomorrow again.

title: Finished building the Tuk-tuk Garage
text: What a day. Spent most of today collecting bricks, building and cooking a proper meal. Finished building the Tuk-tuk Garage! Stood back and had a proper look at it. Lekker.
